newsitem.title: UK: DDB NEEDHAM LINKS UP WITH AD AGENCY IN JORDAN.
newsitem.headline: DDB NEEDHAM LINKS UP WITH AD AGENCY IN JORDAN.

text.p: DDB International, part of the U.S.-based DDB Needham advertising agency network, said on Monday it had expanded its Middle East network by joining forces with Idea Advertising Ltd in Amman, Jordan.

In a statement released in London, DDB said Idea Advertising Ltd was formed last January and has already achieved a projected billing figure approaching $1 million for 1997. It serves national clients in Jordan, including Jordan Clothing and United Confectionery.
DDB, part of the U.S.-based holding company Omnicom Group Inc, said the agreement would give the DDB Network an edge against other long-established agencies in Jordan.

"This young, enthusiastic company has been highly successful in gaining business. The DDB Network will work with Idea Advertising to offer our international clients in the area the best possible service," Bernard Brochand, president of DDB International, said.
DDB Needham is the fifth largest advertising network in the world, with 245 offices in 86 countries.
